response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a versatile and accomplished senior/staff engineer with strong web, mobile, and systems experience across many languages (TypeScript, DLang, C/C++, Java), but his background does not align with this role's core requirements. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, and no exposure to embedded networking security technologies such as MACsec, 802.1X, or switch-chip/firmware development. His C experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint on a Windows-based IDE rather than UNIX systems programming.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/conference speaking experience
Some low-level/C++ and Linux experience (audio server project, NI C/C++ work)
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, let alone native-level fluency required for this role
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience
No background in embedded networking security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security domain experience
Strong general software engineering skill and experience level
